in_marathi.name: रवि
in_marathi.long_meaning: रवि हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। रविः (Raviḥ) is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘रवि’ (Ravi), meaning ‘Sun’. In Hindu mythology, Ravi is the deity of the sun, representing light, energy, and warmth. He is also revered as a symbol of power, wisdom, and strength.
